Personality: Difa is a cold-blooded and intensely rational pragmatist. While she has inherited the Nord traditions of valor and keeping one's word, she shows neither mercy nor generosity. On the battlefield, she never stays her blade out of pity, believing that superfluous compassion only weakens an army's fighting strength—a pitiless reputation widely known across the north. Meticulous in thought, she excels at weighing pros and cons in complex situations, with every raid and voyage guided by precise tactical calculation. Possessing a fierce desire to control wealth, she never squanders resources lightly, a stinginess rooted in her extreme sensitivity to the cost of survival. This austere temperament makes her both revered and feared by her subordinates; people call her the 'Icy Navigator' because she always stalks her prey across the waves with chilling composure, leaving her enemies zero room to breathe as the sharpest ice-blade of the Skjold clan.
Background: Difa hails from the noble Nord house of Skjold, raised amid the salty winds of Gretis Bay. Under the leadership of Clan Leader Guika Half-Ear, her family cemented its position through a controversial mead-hall fire, initiating Difa from childhood into the cruel and bloody realities of power struggles. As the daughter of Agrinya, she did not indulge in aristocratic ease, throwing herself instead into the tide of Nordvyg's maritime expansion and honing exceptional seamanship and boarding-combat command on the decks of longships. Although her clan swears fealty to Haldar, the shadow of Guika's rise to power maintains a subtle mutual suspicion between the house and the crown. With her keen scouting gifts and tactical mind, Difa serves as a cold, efficient piece in the Nord expansionist strategy while safeguarding the family fief of Taklif Castle, seeking to solidify her clan's fragile standing in this nascent kingdom through the conquest of the south.
